name: 管道水力计算（流速/压降）

map.根据达西-魏斯巴赫公式计算圆管流速、雷诺数、沿程阻力及压降，适用于常温清水。: Computes circular-pipe velocity, Reynolds number, friction resistance, and pressure drop by the Darcy-Weisbach equation; for clean water at room temperature.
map.管道压降 = 沿程+局部损失: Pipe pressure drop = friction + minor losses
map.沿程水头损失采用达西-魏斯巴赫公式：hf = λ·(L/D)·(v²/2g): Friction head loss uses Darcy-Weisbach: hf = \u03bb\u00b7(L/D)\u00b7(v\u00b2/2g)
map.摩擦系数 λ 通过 Colebrook-White 方程迭代求解: Friction factor \u03bb solved iteratively via Colebrook-White
map.📚 深度解析：管道水力（流速与压降）计算: 📚 In-depth: Pipe Hydraulics (Velocity and Pressure Drop)
map.按流量与管径算经济流速，再核压降。: From flow and diameter compute economic velocity, then check pressure drop.
map.长距离输水校核沿程与局部总损失。: Long-distance conveyance: verify total friction and minor losses.
map.改 DN150 流速降到 1.13 m/s，沿程损失降至约 1.3 m，省泵功但: DN150 lowers velocity to 1.13 m/s and friction to ~1.3 m; saves pump power but more pipe cost.
map.给水常 0.6~1.5、工艺水可更高，权衡管材与能耗综合取优。: Water supply often 0.6\u20131.5; process water can be higher; balance pipe cost and energy.
map.短管可忽略，长管与多阀门系统局部损失常占 10%~30%，需计。: Negligible for short pipes; for long pipes and multi-valve systems minor losses are often 10%\u201330% and must be counted.
map.流速 v = (流量÷3600) ÷ (πD²÷4)（流量先由 m³/h 化 m: Velocity v = (flow÷3600) ÷ (πD²÷4) (flow converted from m³/h to m³/s, diameter from mm to m); Reynolds number Re = v×D÷ν; friction loss hf = λ×(L÷D)×(v²÷2g), minor loss hj = ζ×(v²÷2g), total pressure drop ΔP (kPa) = (hf+hj)×9.81. Validation: flow or diameter ≤0 prompts «please enter a valid flow and diameter». Verdict: λ is chosen by flow regime — Re <2300 laminar 64/Re, <4000 transitional 0.3164/Re^0.25, turbulent with relative roughness >0 solved iteratively with the Colebrook equation.
